summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Gullak Studio admin panel image upload persistence and site content editing. All root causes fixed: (1) api.js uses relative /api URLs, (2) server.py stores uploads in MongoDB + disk cache, (3) ImageUploader uses resolveImg. Image persistence and MongoDB fallback verified working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Path traversal test expected 400 but got 404
minor_issues.impact: None - path traversal is still blocked, just different status code

passed_tests: Admin login works with admin@gullak.com / gullak@admin2025
Admin can view and navigate to all sections: Products, Collections, Site Content, Artisans, Studio Diary, Journal
Admin can create new Studio Diary moment with image upload
Image upload stores file in MongoDB (base64) + disk cache
Uploaded image URL is relative /api/uploads/ path (not hardcoded preview URL)
MongoDB fallback works: removed disk cache file, image still served from MongoDB, disk cache auto-restored
Uploaded test image appears on homepage Studio Diary section
Product images display correctly on storefront
Admin can edit Site Content (hero tagline, headline)
Site Content changes appear instantly on frontend homepage
All public catalog endpoints work (home, collections, products, journal, artisans)
Image serving endpoint GET /api/uploads/{filename} works correctly
Admin CRUD operations work for products, collections, journal, artisans, studio moments

detailed_verification.root_cause_1_fixed: ✅ api.js now uses relative /api base URL in deployed environments (getBackendBase() returns empty string for non-localhost)
detailed_verification.root_cause_2_fixed: ✅ server.py stores uploads in MongoDB (base64 in uploads collection) AND on disk as cache. Verified by checking MongoDB document and testing fallback.
detailed_verification.root_cause_3_fixed: ✅ ImageUploader.jsx uses resolveImg from api.js instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL
detailed_verification.mongodb_fallback_test: ✅ Removed disk cache file /app/backend/uploads/3f2475d9dd4243c7a18e4531f453c991.png, requested image via API, got 289 bytes (same size), disk cache was auto-restored
detailed_verification.image_persistence_test: ✅ Uploaded test image (blue square), refreshed page, image still loads correctly with relative /api/uploads/ URL
detailed_verification.frontend_display_test: ✅ Test image appears on homepage, product images display correctly on storefront
